facts.fact: The Eswatini Data Protection Authority lists an enforcement notice under section 41 of the Data Protection Act 2022 issued to the Royal Science Technology Park (RSTP) in March 2025.
The Authority lists enforcement notices under section 41 of the Act issued in June 2024 to MTN Eswatini and to Liberty Life Swaziland Limited.
The Authority's dated enforcement notices under section 41 of the Act, the latest in March 2025, show the Act in operation.
The Eswatini Data Protection Authority, operating its own site, issued enforcement notices under the Act in June 2024 and March 2025.
